fields.description:
Excellent 360° Rotating Dustproof Organizer - A Smart Solution
This organizer's air-tight crystal clear lid keeps your makeup brushes completely safe from dust and harmful bacteria. And its 360-degree smooth rotation with side metal bearings lets you find any tool you want in just 1 second.

Material: High-grade thick shatterproof acrylic and premium ABS
Number of compartments: 7 separate slots (for different sized brushes)
Rotation mechanism: 360 degree stainless steel silent ball-bearing
Cover type: Dustproof and waterproof crystal clear dome lid
Dimensions: 12.5 cm diameter x 25 cm height (approx.)
Cleaning method: Easy to open and washable with plain water

fields.shortDescription: Premium retro lantern with Type-C fast charging, rotary dimmer light, and 8-10 hours long backup.
fields.shortDescriptionBn: Premium retro lantern with Type-C fast charging, rotary dimmer light, and 8-10 hours long backup.
fields.description:
Exquisite retro vintage lantern - the perfect combination of light and elegance
Combining the historic royal design of an ancient hurricane lantern with modern LED technology, its warm amber light soothes the mood, the rotary knob can be used to dim the light as desired, and it provides a full night's worth of backup on a single charge.

Design: Vintage Hurricane Style (Matte Black/Bronze Finish)
Light source: Warm Amber LED Filament (Eye-Friendly Cozy Warm Light)
Dimming mechanism: Stepless Rotary Knob (Smooth Rotary Dimmer Knob)
Charging port: USB Type-C (Mobile charger or power bank supported)
Material and finish: Metal oil rubbed with a matte finish
Dimensions: 16.5 x 9.5 cm (16.5 x 9.5cm)
Color: Vintage Scarlet Red (Scarlet Red with Black Metal Cage & Hook)
Light source: High-brightness warm LED filament (LED Lights)
Voltage and power mode: ≤36V, Battery Powered, USB Dual Use
Control mode: Stepless Rotary Dimmer Knob

fields.name: Ceramic Hen Lead Golden Wire Egg Storage Basket & Kitchen Decor
fields.nameBn: Ceramic Hen Lead Golden Wire Egg Storage Basket & Kitchen Decor
fields.shortDescription: This egg basket with a cute ceramic hen lid and premium golden wire cage will hold 20-25 eggs, perfectly safe and open.
fields.shortDescriptionBn: This egg basket with a cute ceramic hen lid and premium golden wire cage will hold 20-25 eggs, perfectly safe and open.
fields.description:
Exquisite Ceramic Hen Golden Wire Basket - A Tasteful Solution
This basket's diamond wire frame ensures 360-degree natural air circulation, keeping eggs fresh and sweat-free at room temperature. And its sweet ceramic hen lid brings a touch of European village farmhouse elegance to the dining table.

Lid material: Hand-painted smooth ceramic / food-grade ABS (white body, pink wing, red comb)
Basket frame: Heavy-duty wrought iron wire (electroplated luxury golden finish)
Egg capacity: 20 to 25 large sized domestic or poultry eggs
Dimensions	Height: about 22 cm, diameter 19.5-20 cm
Handle system: Dual side metal wire handle for easy one-handed carrying
Base Protection: Smooth rounded support base that won't scratch the table surface
